subject: Database Management System
chapters: Chapter 3: Relational Model and Relational Algebra
Chapter 6: Transaction Processing and Concurrency Control

questions.text: Define Database Management System (DBMS). Compare Traditional File Processing System vs DBMS in terms of data redundancy, inconsistency, access, and security.
Explain ANSI-SPARC Three-Schema Architecture (Physical, Logical, View levels). Explain Physical Data Independence and Logical Data Independence.
Define Entity, Entity Set, Attribute, and Relationship. Explain types of attributes: Simple vs Composite, Single-valued vs Multi-valued, Derived, and Key attributes.

Draw an ER Diagram for a University Management System (Students, Courses, Instructors, Departments) showing Entity Sets, Attributes, Primary Keys, Cardinality Ratios (1:1, 1:N, M:N), and Participation Constraints.
Explain Extended ER (EER) features: Specialization, Generalization, Aggregation, and Attribute Inheritance with examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Relational Model and Relational Algebra
questions.text: Define Relational Model concepts: Relation, Tuple, Attribute, Domain, Cardinality, and Degree. Explain Keys: Super Key, Candidate Key, Primary Key, Foreign Key, and Alternate Key.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Relational Model and Relational Algebra
questions.text: Explain Integrity Constraints in Relational Model: Entity Integrity Constraint, Referential Integrity Constraint, and Domain Constraint.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Relational Model and Relational Algebra
questions.text: Explain Relational Algebra Operations: Select ($\sigma$), Project ($\pi$), Cartesian Product ($	imes$), Union ($\cup$), Set Difference ($-$), Rename ($ho$), Natural Join ($ owtie$), Outer Joins ($\left\ outer  owtie ight\ outer$), and Division ($\div$).

Differentiate between Data Definition Language (DDL: `CREATE`, `ALTER`, `DROP`), Data Manipulation Language (DML: `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`), Data Control Language (DCL: `GRANT`, `REVOKE`), and TCL (`COMMIT`, `ROLLBACK`).

Given schema: `Employee(emp_id, emp_name, salary, dept_id)`, `Department(dept_id, dept_name, location)`. Write SQL queries: (a) Find highest salary in each department, (b) Find employees earning more than average salary, (c) List departments with > 5 employees.
Define Functional Dependency (FD). Explain Armstrong's Axioms (Reflexivity, Augmentation, Transitivity) and attribute closure $X^+$.
Explain Database Normalization. Explain 1NF, 2NF (Partial Dependency removal), 3NF (Transitive Dependency removal), and BCNF (Boyce-Codd Normal Form) with relational decomposition examples.
Given relation $R(A, B, C, D, E)$ with FDs: $A \rightarrow B$, $BC \rightarrow D$, $E \rightarrow C$. Find candidate keys for $R$ and determine the highest Normal Form of $R$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Transaction Processing and Concurrency Control
questions.text: Define Transaction. Explain ACID Properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) and Transaction State Transition Diagram.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Transaction Processing and Concurrency Control
questions.text: Explain Serializability. Differentiate between Conflict Serializability and View Serializability. Test if a given schedule $S: r_1(X), w_1(X), r_2(X), w_2(X)$ is conflict serializable using Precedence Graph.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Transaction Processing and Concurrency Control
questions.text: Explain Concurrency Control Protocols: Two-Phase Locking (2PL: Growing & Shrinking phase, Strict 2PL, Rigorous 2PL), Timestamp Ordering Protocol, and Deadlock Handling (Prevention, Detection, Recovery).
Explain Log-Based Database Recovery techniques: Deferred Update (NO-UNDO/REDO) vs Immediate Update (UNDO/REDO) protocols and Checkpointing.
Explain Database Security and Authorization. Explain Discretionary Access Control (DAC) using SQL `GRANT`/`REVOKE` and Mandatory Access Control (MAC) using security levels.
